# Decontamination Solvent Standard

The decontamination standard for laboratory equipment surfaces.

## Required Solvent

The required solvent for decontaminating equipment surfaces is 90% isopropyl
alcohol. Saturate a wipe and cover the full surface, leaving it visibly wet for
at least one minute of contact time before drying.
